mapper.select: SELECT db_id AS "db_id", instance_name AS "instance_name" FROM apm_db_info ORDER BY db_id
SELECT db_id, instance_name FROM apm_db_info ORDER BY db_id

WITH part_list AS ( SELECT p.table_name, p.partition_name, TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(p.partition_name, 8, 3)) AS db_id, TRUNC(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(p.partition_name, 2, 6), 'RRMMDD')) AS part_dt FROM dba_tab_partitions p WHERE p.table_owner = USER AND REGEXP_LIKE(p.partition_name, '^P[0-9]{9}$') ) SELECT pl.table_name || ' / ' || pl.partition_name AS "partition_to_drop" FROM part_list pl LEFT JOIN apm_db_info d ON pl.db_id = d.db_id LEFT JOIN apm_partition_manage m ON m.table_name = pl.table_name AND m.db_id = pl.db_id WHERE pl.db_id = #{dbId} AND (m.retention_days IS NULL OR pl.part_dt < TRUNC(SYSDATE) - m.retention_days) ORDER BY pl.table_name, pl.partition_name

WITH part_list AS ( SELECT regexp_replace(t.tablename, '_p[0-9]{9}$', '') AS table_name, t.tablename AS partition_name, t.schemaname AS schema_name, substring(t.tablename from '_p[0-9]{6}([0-9]{3})$')::int AS db_id, to_date(substring(t.tablename from '_p([0-9]{6})[0-9]{3}$'), 'YYMMDD') AS part_dt FROM pg_tables t WHERE t.schemaname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema','public') AND t.tablename ~ '_p[0-9]{9}$' ) SELECT p.table_name || ' / ' || p.partition_name AS "partition_to_drop" FROM part_list p LEFT JOIN apm_db_info d ON p.db_id = d.db_id LEFT JOIN apm_partition_manage m ON m.table_name = p.table_name AND m.db_id = p.db_id WHERE p.db_id = #{dbId} AND (m.retention_days IS NULL OR p.part_dt < CURRENT_DATE - m.retention_days) ORDER BY p.table_name, p.partition_name

WITH part_list AS ( SELECT t.schemaname AS schema_name, regexp_replace(t.tablename, '_p[0-9]{9}$', '') AS table_name, t.tablename AS partition_name, substring(t.tablename from '_p[0-9]{6}([0-9]{3})$')::int AS db_id, to_date(substring(t.tablename from '_p([0-9]{6})[0-9]{3}$'), 'YYMMDD') AS part_dt FROM pg_tables t WHERE t.schemaname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema','public') AND t.tablename ~ '_p[0-9]{9}$' ) SELECT p.schema_name AS "schema_name", p.table_name AS "table_name", p.partition_name AS "partition_name" FROM part_list p LEFT JOIN apm_partition_manage m ON m.table_name = p.table_name AND m.db_id = p.db_id WHERE p.db_id = #{dbId} AND (m.retention_days IS NULL OR p.part_dt < CURRENT_DATE - m.retention_days) ORDER BY p.partition_name
